en: The postcard features a vintage photograph of a tree-lined street with ornate houses and historic buildings. The street is identified as 'Pädagogiumstraße' in the town of Bad Pyrmont, Germany, as indicated by the printed text. The verso (reverse side) contains handwritten correspondence in German, a green postage stamp, postal marks, and the recipient's address in Bielefeld. There is also a blue stamp referring to 'MUSEUM SCHLOSS PYRMONT.'
